CodeElement: Scheduled decisions and single-writer execution
CurrentRuleOrGuard: One transaction per call processes due keys. Perception batches care, foraging, nutrition and excavation in that order. Resolution processes batched physical actions. Reschedule batches autonomy. Environment dispatches physiology, lifecycle, reproduction, resource release and trail maintenance.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Phase ordering and resolver clocks encode replay and transaction guarantees. Relative phase position is not a sensory latency or temporal priority observed in an ant.

CodeElement: Actor ownership and same-boundary competition
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Ordinary actions permit the earliest proposal per actor, ordered among actors by resource and seed/time/resource/actor hash. CareBegin and CareEnd use the separate pending-bout check before ordinary eligibility.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Actor ownership, resource arbitration, revision checks and care reservation are conflict semantics. A deterministic winner is not a measured dominance, assessment or task-choice process.

CodeElement: Engineering guards and published-state restoration
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Distinguish spatial, motion, retrieval, care, guarded maternal, long-term and base checkpoint variants. Reconstruct events, IDs, queues, policies, ledgers and occupancy from saved state and facts.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Checkpoint variant selection, validation and restored pending events establish continuity of the simulated state. They cannot validate biology.

CodeElement: Observation window and evidence typing
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Half-open count windows. Task residence and care residence are separate from known active/inactive bouts and time outside the union of known intervals. Count opportunities, selections, starts, completions, interruptions and actual transferred mass separately.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Active handling-positive scans per queen, first marker per queen or trio, and oral-contact episodes per worker group
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Opportunity, selected, started, residence and completion have distinct denominators. Timeless facts and passive carrying are not positive B01 scans. A B02 placement is not necessarily the deposited retrieval marker.

CodeElement: Inspection-only targeted queen telemetry
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Read exact targeted queen state and record whether the queen was sampled or spatially reachable in a separate inspection output.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A targeted queen query is read-only telemetry. The sampled or reachable outcome is not an ordinary ant's global knowledge and is not an independently observed feeding event.

CodeElement: History observation across published and live facts
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Capture seals the current tail without changing simulation facts. Acknowledgement validates prefix identity and size before retiring only published chunks. Read resumes from the durable prefix or in-memory journal.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Fact prefix capture, durable publication and live/durable reads preserve traceability. Record availability is not evidence for any biological choice.

CodeElement: Fixture life-stage override and cleanup
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Accept next ordinal live stage only for an unphysiologized individual, or forced death. Reject a skipped stage or repeated death. Interrupt care on a stage change.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: An externally injected next stage or death is an experimental intervention. It supplies no natural transition hazard or duration.

CodeElement: Food components, depot and explicit inputs
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Create a nonempty source. Surface worlds require a unique walkable food cell. Collection and delivery move the same components into carried and colony stocks.
EvidenceLocators: B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Offered diets, feeding rates and offspring counts per founded colony
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Four-component available mass, one food source per cell and the accessible aggregate depot are representations. Offered volume or prey length is not assimilated component mass or spatial depot capacity. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Contact neighborhood and exact filtering
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Sample without replacement using Floyd ranks up to encounter_budget before physical filtering. Excluded identities consume sampled slots. Sort accepted candidates by ID. Unbounded mode enumerates all identities before the same filter.
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Recorded mouth-to-mouth bouts and directed worker networks per colony/run; bout duration in seconds
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Pre-filter uniform bucket-rank sampling, excluded-slot consumption and the candidate cap have no empirical counterpart in these studies. Bout observations miss unsuccessful candidate draws.

CodeElement: Separate cargo, crop, body stores and losses
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Source/nest/crop/body quantities and consumed sinks are distinct. Endogenous birth initial state is linked by mother and not counted again as external input. Inert other material occupies storage capacity.
EvidenceLocators: FT01: p. 3 and pp. 6–13, Table 1, Figs. 5–9 | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | FT01-X: journal p. 13 and Fig. S1, PDF p. 18 (other species)
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Queen flight-muscle and adipocyte histology by day, dry sexual body combustion energy, worker body composition
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Ledger preserves source, crop, tissue and losses but has no flight-muscle or lipid reserve accessible for founding. No conversion of histology or combustion energy into initial usable body stores. FT01-X illustrates three collection-to-fixation intervals in P. crassinoda and cannot supply a L. niger rate.

CodeElement: Recipient ingredient deficit and eligibility signal
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Deficits subtract crop reserves from body headroom and protein targets. Signal larval protein deficit, and in long-term mode urgent larval energy/water. Adult signal uses sub-quarter body reserves or deficient adult crop protein target.
EvidenceLocators: B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species | B07-X: Dryad Lasius_pulseisotopedata.txt and author pulse script, 32 labeled caste/time aliquots
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Colony growth by diet; compartment tracer enrichment in L. neoniger; worker interactions under deprivation
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Other ants do not demonstrably know a recipient's exact deficit. The one-quarter thresholds, crop subtraction and stage eligibility lack controlled L. niger evidence. Cross-species enrichment is not recipient solicitation. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Automatic donor recipient selection and action priority
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Default action is Rest. Gift-first tries compatible Nurse transfer first unless the donor is urgent without matching crop. Recycling in Rest can precede intake. Otherwise intake uses cargo then reachable depot below half crop, followed by legacy gift attempt when enabled by that order.
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | R1L: pp. 154–158, 161–164, 172; Tables 1, 3–5
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed forager vs non-forager donation counts; individual overlap of retrieving, feeding and foraging
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Observed foragers donated frequently in B08. Nurse-only automatic giving is a narrower role gate, and a measured feeder is not necessarily in the software Forage program. Gift-first precedence and rest recycling have no measured transition law.

CodeElement: Intake from cargo and accessible depot
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Bound intake by requested mass, available supply and crop room. Long-term depot withdrawal caps each ingredient by own demand, or max of own and freshly sampled recipient demands for Nurse.
EvidenceLocators: N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed access to food, oral interactions after feeding and founding productivity by offered diet
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Minimum bounds conserve mass. The maximum of exact local recipient deficits, scalar crop limits and depot withdrawal clock do not follow from feeding endpoints.

CodeElement: Validated ordinary mouth-to-mouth transfer
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Reject invalid/dead/unreachable recipient, disabled exchange, no room or supply. Demand-sensitive mode intersects donor crop and recipient ingredient deficit. Transfer proportional bounded integer composition between crops.
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | R1L: pp. 154–158, 161–164, 172; Tables 1, 3–5
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Directed oral contacts, seconds per worker bout, and observed regurgitation to queens and larvae
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: An ordinary event atomically moves compatible crop components. Physical oral contact duration, solicitation and acceptance, composition and dose were not measured together for the simulated recipient castes and stages.

CodeElement: Protein surplus return and post-intake wake
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Move requested bounded pure protein from crop back to depot when allowed. Auto recycling selects Rest with protein at reachable depot. A successful Nurse NestIngested may schedule the next contact wake at +1 ms.
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Worker transfer counts and durations. Pure protein deposition to a reusable nest pool was not measured.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Pure protein return and the one-millisecond recontact scheduling are fixture mechanisms. This batch cannot infer secretion, protein reclamation or biological re-encounter time.

CodeElement: Worker provisioning of queens versus larval nutrition
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Queen adult_protein_target_ug can make stored crop protein eligible for provision. No separate weighted queen recipient priority. Adult received protein remains crop stock available to funded egg allocation or transfer.
EvidenceLocators: R1L: pp. 154–158, 161–164, 172; Tables 1, 3–5 | B01: pp. 1047, 1049–1051, §§2.2.3 and 3.2, Fig. 1b; supplementary Fig. S5 cited in main text | B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B | B03: Appendices S1–S2, day-49 queen endpoints and Table S2-2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed worker regurgitation to queens, care under hand feeding, and foundress productivity under offered diets All 240 observed endpoints retained in the descriptive check. The weekly-cricket treatment is an offered diet.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Worker-to-queen supply is possible. Neither relative selection of mother vs larva, queen crop protein target nor dose is measured by the used endpoints. B01 feeding addresses care, not worker-to-queen flux.

CodeElement: Physiology registration and exact initial reserves
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Initialize all compartments, first absorption clock and owned physiology event. Long intervals, alternate water clock and queen-specific adult crop target require long-term contract.
EvidenceLocators: FT01: p. 3 and pp. 6–13, Table 1, Figs. 5–9 | B04: §§2.2–2.3, 4.1, Table 1, Fig. 1A caption | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B04: Data S1 pp. 2–3 and Fig. S5 p. 11 | FT01-X: journal p. 13 and Fig. S1, PDF p. 18 (other species)
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Foundress tissue remodeling, adult/pool mass and oxygen flux; sexual whole-body combustion energy
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Explicit initialized stores and a first wake are computational, not a mass/age/temperature mapping. Endogenous histolysis and stage-specific usable reserves are missing. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay. FT01-X illustrates three collection-to-fixation intervals in P. crassinoda and cannot supply a L. niger rate.

CodeElement: Piecewise basal and task-state energy cost
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Apply basal_nj_per_ms for every live stage and add active_nj_per_ms for an Adult in Nurse, Forage or Excavate. Debit min(current energy, rate * elapsed) and count dissipation.
EvidenceLocators: N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B04: §§2.2–2.3, 4.1, Table 1, Fig. 1A caption | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B04: Data S1 pp. 2–3 and Fig. S5 p. 11
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Rest-context oxygen flux per queen or worker estimate, mass-normalized rate and developing sexual respiration
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Caste and life stage differ experimentally. The fixture basal and task premium do not follow from oxygen measurements. A program label, including waiting, is not measured movement or loaded work. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

CodeElement: Discrete assimilation and bounded energy conversion
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Convert eligible crop carbohydrate by fixed nJ per ug and store water. Only larvae move crop protein into tissue up to the larval requirement. Eggs/pupae advance the absorption clock without substrate transfer.
EvidenceLocators: B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species | B07-X: Dryad Lasius_pulseisotopedata.txt and author pulse script, 32 labeled caste/time aliquots
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Dry tissue combustion energy, whole colony dietary response, and non-target tracer enrichment
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Fixed pulse, rate, energy yield and larval-only protein assimilation are a simple mass/energy budget. Oxygen and whole dry-body energy cannot identify usable crop carbohydrate yield or absorption timing. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Water store and loss dynamics
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Accumulate integer water loss with remainder and debit at most current hydration. Crop water can replenish hydration at Adult/Larva absorption pulses.
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B01: pp. 1045–1047, 1049, §§2.1, 2.2.1, 3.1 | B01: Data S1 Fig. S4 and Dryad Brood_production.txt
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Access to water under foundress care and thermal rearing conditions. No caste-specific loss flux in these measurements. First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The constant water clock, integer storage and depletion threshold have no RH, temperature or evaporation law. Water availability does not determine individual water mass or uptake rates.

CodeElement: Missing environmental and allometric physiology
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Parameter values can differ by externally selected individual fixture. No caste or ontogenetic scaling function, dynamic temperature development response, respiration or diapause.
EvidenceLocators: N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B04: §§2.2–2.3, 4.1, Table 1, Fig. 1A caption | B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B04: Data S1 pp. 2–3 and Fig. S5 p. 11
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Distinct oxygen estimates by caste, stage-specific oxygen flux and geographic thermal development curves
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Caste/size and temperature do not drive the simulated rates. A correlation with adult mass or a thermal stage table does not authorize a universal multiplier. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

CodeElement: Physiological egg, larva, pupa and adult transition
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Egg and pupa progress if alive. Larval stage time accrues only after tissue requirement. At exact stage duration update to next ordinal on same ID and reset progress.
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | B01: Data S1 Fig. S4 and Dryad Brood_production.txt | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Egg, larval, combined prepupal/pupal and total days, with temperature and population; colony diet and tracer outcomes First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: At 17 C larvae entered diapause in B06. The model has invariant stage settings and a discontinuous tissue gate. Diet affects cohort outcomes; neither cohort growth nor non-target isotope enrichment identifies a threshold. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Instars, callow maturation and reproductive caste differentiation
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Larval instars, molts, prepupa and post-emergence maturation have no distinct executable states. Funded reproduction initializes worker eggs. Male and queen may be explicitly seeded as castes.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Prepupal and cocoon interval, callow or age-marked worker conditions, and sexual cohort investment
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The stage enum lacks prepupa, instars, molts, callow maturation and reproductive development. B06 pooled two observed stages for measurement. The worker-only funded birth path is not caste determination.

CodeElement: Physiological death and terminal scheduling
CurrentRuleOrGuard: A zero energy or water store commits Dead. Energy wins the cause label when both are zero. Clear owned physiology, nutrition, reproduction, foraging, excavation, care and autonomy work.
EvidenceLocators: B01: pp. 1045–1047, 1049, §§2.1, 2.2.1, 3.1 | B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B01: Data S1 Fig. S4 and Dryad Brood_production.txt
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Survival and brood emergence under controlled founding, with water and temperature treatments in different studies First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Zero energy/hydration kills all modeled stages and simultaneous depletion has deterministic precedence. Mortality cause, biological tolerance and aging are unresolved; broader mortality is deferred.

CodeElement: Funded maternal egg production
CurrentRuleOrGuard: At fixed cadence synchronize maternal state. Require crop protein at least egg cost and strict water and energy surplus after egg plus maintenance. Integrated ongoing care is interrupted only on a funded birth.
EvidenceLocators: B01: pp. 1048–1049, 1053, §§2.2.13–2.2.14, 3.8; Fig. 4a only | B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B | FT01: p. 3 and pp. 6–13, Table 1, Figs. 5–9 | B03: Appendices S1–S2, day-49 queen endpoints and Table S2-2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Egg-count trajectories with larvae by founding stage, cohort productivity under diet and postmating tissue remodeling All 240 observed endpoints retained in the descriptive check. The weekly-cricket treatment is an offered diet.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: No age/stage-dependent larval feedback or internally remobilized protein pool. Discrete cadence and strict reserve minima are not measured. The maintenance horizon has no direct empirical value.

CodeElement: Offspring funding, inheritance and enrollment
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Subtract egg protein and water, export egg energy and record separate reproductive dissipation. Copy mother's physiology coefficients to child and set adult protein target to zero.
EvidenceLocators: B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Sexual cohort energetic investment, caste-specific adult oxygen flux and stage days
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Identity is preserved and debits are real. Whole queen investment is not per-egg allocation. Copying maternal coefficients and zeroing juvenile adult protein demand do not have direct support.

CodeElement: Indexed care perception and contact opportunity
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Enumerate reachable neighbors using the contact index, then screen for relevant brood and adult workers. Enumerate in-range opportunities before displaced-target lock filtering.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Time to visible contact per assay unit; recorded antennation and active brood manipulation per queen Mesh analysis has 43 queens and 127 retained observation windows.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Metric radius, exact local coordinates, neighbor filtering and one opportunity per queried decision precede visible contact. The endpoints do not measure detection distance, sensory latency or the true encounter denominator.

CodeElement: Species, individual and environment care enrollment
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Profile is installed once before execution. Dedicated enrollment requires pause and initial reachable shelter contact, then stores familiar shelter and immutable individual context.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed brood care in solitary queens and workers, with staged social manipulations First observed worker day 62.88 ± 2.52 SD in 17 worker-producing foundresses at 21 C.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Enrollment, a familiar-shelter position, explicit context enum and setup criteria are representations. Founding/established labels do not themselves change the integrated decision law.

CodeElement: Finite lease alongside ordinary autonomy
CurrentRuleOrGuard: At depot check accessible stimuli. Off depot, require stored shelter and a valid reducing step. Preserve normal program decision wake while care owns motor, then release back to ordinary policy.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Queen care varies after worker manipulation; workers can retrieve and feed in repeated individual observations
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: One motor lease, a single return point and ordinary program pausing constrain coexistence. B01's age/social effects are not explained by lease release, and observed worker role flexibility does not identify lease duration.

CodeElement: Successful worker contact and temporary queen inhibition
CurrentRuleOrGuard: When eligible draw contact separately before brood handling. A completed CloseWorkerContact records the only contact-memory refresh. Linear recency multiplier depresses the queen's new brood-choice probability.
EvidenceLocators: B01: pp. 1045–1048, 1049–1052, §§2.1.4, 2.2.3–2.2.5, 2.2.8–2.2.12; §§3.1–3.6, Figs. 1–2 | B01: pp. 1047, 1049–1051, §§2.2.3 and 3.2, Fig. 1b; supplementary Fig. S5 cited in main text | B01: Data S1 Fig. S3, Tables S1–S2, Appendix S1 wire-mesh exclusions
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Active-care scan fraction after addition/removal, mesh separation, and food manipulation per queen Mesh analysis has 43 queens and 127 retained observation windows.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Mesh admitted antennation; the intervention did not isolate a single contact type. Only committed simulated contact refreshes a linearly decaying memory. Its shape, horizon, probability and worker age dependence lack evidence.

CodeElement: Brood acquisition, short persistence and approach
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Prefer displaced brood when any is visible. Screen displaced locks owned by others and clear active target on loss. Draw uniformly when starting, otherwise retain only a still-visible displaced target.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Brood contacts, subsequent retrieval and preferential ranks across brood stages and conditions
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Uniform selection, immediate exact positions, displaced-first rule, locks and visibility-based persistence are additional assumptions. The assay gives no first sensory detection time or initial location distribution.

CodeElement: Stationary brood handling and real feeding
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Choose uniformly among Inspect, Arrange, Clean, and Feed only if compatible nutrition is already carried and target is a physiological larva.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Antennation, handling and relocation observations; separated licking and regurgitation counts
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Equal choice weights and the feed eligibility check are model rules. Neither observation establishes a cleansing benefit, transferred mass or protein delivery duration.

CodeElement: Timed pickup, movement with custody and placement
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Revalidate life, stage, ownership, range and path at start and finish. Successful pickup records custody and, under continuous motion, the relative grip offset. Loaded segments move both bodies atomically.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Number returned, first retrieving marker, visual orientation choices and timed worker returns
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Custody locks, fixed relative grip and sweep constraints establish physical consistency. Trained worker path timing exists, but the B02 assay does not separate pickup, loaded motion and placement times. The reviewed model overcounts retrievals under the tested line layout.

CodeElement: Movement segment duration, clearance and legacy stride
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Continuous movement clips straight toward target and can try local reducing axes if blocked. Legacy timed surface motion requires a step at least one cell. Timed duration rounds up distance/speed, with one-millisecond floor or arrangement minimum.
EvidenceLocators: R1C: pp. 276–281, 290–296, Tables II and IV | B02: pp. 10411–10413, §§2.2–2.3, §3; Fig. 1; Dryad all-data table
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Trained loaded paths in two workers and composite first-retrieving times
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The three-dimensional clearance, reducing-axis fallback and ceiling of distance/speed are algorithms. Selected loaded paths cannot identify population distributions across caste and load, or empty-view movement.

CodeElement: Search, one pickup-site revisit and return to shelter
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Choose return, revisit or local acquisition according to current state. Dedicated empty-view walk draws one of four planar directions. Search counter reloads when empty and is a cadence counter, not a lifetime search cap.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Repeat returns after a brood delivery, direction under training, and repeat-carrier overlap
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The one-site revisit, equal planar direction choices and resettable search count are fixtures. Bouts do not identify visual landmarks, site memory, pheromone or their interplay.

CodeElement: Cancellation and reacquisition boundaries
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Release lock and cancel queued care on interruption. Retain already committed positions. Geometry edit rechecks active segment and both positions where applicable.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Incomplete retrieval and repeat carriers under assay conditions
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Deterministic lock release, stage/death invalidation and geometry-based cancellation are engineering requirements. No comparable hazard for giving up, clearance failure or reacquisition is measured.

CodeElement: Neutral foreign-brood displacement assay
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Permit local foreign displaced Larva/Pupa approach, pickup, transport and placement, retaining colony identity. Suppress selection of sheltered foreign brood unless currently held.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Origin-paired transport counts and brood rank/adoption in separate seasonal tests
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Walsh did not detect a difference in its setup; Lenoir found conditional preferences. Neutral displaced transport is a scoped experiment and does not imply unconditional natural brood acceptance or unchanged ColonyId in biology.

CodeElement: Dedicated care fact lifecycle and interval semantics
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Record Opportunity and Selected separately. Only successful start creates known-duration Started. Completed requires success or partial committed outcome at end. Failure records Interrupted with actual payload.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed scans, timestamps or contacts in three incompatible measurement protocols
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Committed lifecycle events distinguish actual starts, attempts and partial results. B01 handling-positive scans and B02 returned items require separate extraction. Duration-unknown wrappers cannot be treated as measured time.

CodeElement: Biological behaviors without modeled physiological outcomes
CurrentRuleOrGuard: No separate maternal saliva, active hygiene state, disease/waste model, larval instar, body rotation, transport attachment mechanics or qualitative brood acceptance policy.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Brood handling, licking, feeding observations and queen tissue histology
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: An event name does not implement guarding, hygiene efficacy, maternal oral processes, physiological remodeling or brood acceptance. No measured endpoints for these outcomes in model history.

CodeElement: Proposed key -> Scheduled or rejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Validated submission or internal wake insertion. Reject past keys, keys at/before same-time watermark and host overflow. Assign new scheduled ID and sequence. Count pending conflict. Journal the insertion
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The persisted key watermark, sequence and insertion limits ensure deterministic replay.

CodeElement: Due events -> Perception / Resolution / Reschedule / dispatch
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Minimum key due at or before target. Perception order care -> foraging -> nutrition -> excavation. Resolution commits before Reschedule. Execute the corresponding batch or event. Finish at target. Failures unwind the call
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The resolver order applies due events. It does not assign an observed cognitive sequence to ants.

CodeElement: Scheduled -> Eligible / ActionRejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Resolution boundary. Earliest for actor. Actor alive Adult Worker. Position revision unchanged. Resource/tie hash orders actors. Route eligible action to type-specific commit. Otherwise record duplicate/dead/stage/stale rejection
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Adult Worker ownership, sequence arbitration and revision rejection are authoritative action rules, not measured choice or dominance.

CodeElement: CareBegin or CareEnd -> Execute or inert tick
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Resolution after same-boundary ownership might have changed. Pending id and enabled care must agree. Call execute_care_action or record CareTick without completing a biological bout
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: An obsolete scheduled bout becomes inert. Ownership prevents duplicate physical acts.

CodeElement: Candidate frame -> Authoritative state or reject
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Host restore request. Format/profile, checksums and continuation/fact invariants must match. Decode and validate before swapping state
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Format, checksums and continuation checks validate restored software state.

CodeElement: Opportunity / Selected / Started -> Completed / Interrupted / open
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Committed observation facts in the individual history. Only known-duration starts create timed intervals. Endpoints are clipped. Aggregate phase counts, committed mass, task residence and known/unknown activity separately
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: B01 binary scans per queen and B02 returned items per queen/trio
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A clipped known interval can be used with a declared ethogram. An incomplete or passive bout must not be counted as active brood handling.

CodeElement: Live committed facts -> Sealed capture / matching published prefix
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Durable snapshot capture, acknowledgement or restore. Identity, size and preserved ordered chunks must match. Retain complete readable fact sequence without advancing model time
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Sealed captures retain ordered facts. Publication identity and a matching prefix do not validate the event-generating biological rule.

CodeElement: Egg / Larva / Pupa / Adult / Dead -> Next live stage / Dead / ActionRejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Externally scheduled fixture lifecycle event. Only next ordinal for nonphysiological development. Death allowed. Repeated death rejected. Commit stage or death on same ID. Release care ownership and stop dead individual's scheduled programs
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The accepted or rejected fixture transition is determined by host scheduling and ordinal guards, not empirical stage timing.

CodeElement: External request -> Source created / prior receipt / rejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Host command at a safe Input boundary. Valid WorldId, unique command payload and walkable clear position. Surface cell unused. Explicit introduction adds source stock and evidence once
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: World/command identity and one indexed source per clear cell constrain host inputs. This is neither a food quality nor a resource emergence law.

CodeElement: Available bucket identities / exhaustive control -> Accepted sample / filtered
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Individual contact decision. Floyd sample before filtering when bounded. Reject self, dead, foreign colony, distance and wall. Return sorted sampled AntRefs and separate work counts
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Realized worker contact count, timing and network
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Neither dataset observes neighbor ranks or failed draw slots, so it cannot calibrate candidate sample or distance thresholds.

CodeElement: Unregistered living ant -> Owned Physiology wake
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Explicit initialization at unexecuted time zero. Valid seed and configuration. Reject fixture development conflicts and invalid long-term settings. Initialize crop/body/hydration/tissue and schedule earliest physiological boundary
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A setup enrollment and its validation bounds are software preconditions. Study-specific masses do not initialize the model's reserve state.

CodeElement: Live old stores -> Settled energy and loss
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Elapsed simulated time since last update. All live stages basal. Only Adult Forage/Nurse/Excavate adds activity. Dead returns. Debit clamped rate * elapsed and accumulate dissipation
EvidenceLocators: N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B04: §§2.2–2.3, 4.1, Table 1, Fig. 1A caption | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B04: Data S1 pp. 2–3 and Fig. S5 p. 11
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Rest-context and stage-specific oxygen consumption
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Adding a fixed premium for program residence differs from measuring incremental cost during a moving or loaded bout. The shared coefficients omit stage-specific response. Role classification does not supply an exact worker age. Rearing 25 C/50–60% RH is separate from the 20 C oxygen assay.

CodeElement: Live old hydration -> Updated water and remainder
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Elapsed time and fixed loss period. Bound lost mass by stores. Use integer quotient/remainder. Update hydration and lost water
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Water-provisioned founding outcomes, not individual water loss
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Fixed linear loss with an integer remainder is a budget rule. No evaporative or absorption flux was observed in those trials.

CodeElement: Due absorption pulse -> Updated stores or unchanged Egg/Pupa
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Physiology event reaches next_absorption after priority checks. Adult/Larva only for carbs/water. Larva only for tissue protein. Bound by crop, room and rate. Consume crop, credit actual internal stores and schedule next pulse
EvidenceLocators: B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Oxygen/combustion data, diet-dependent growth and non-target isotope enrichment
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Neither scheduled absorption nor absence of egg/pupal substrate use through the crop is quantified by these endpoints. Oxygen use demonstrates metabolism rather than crop assimilation. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Larva below tissue requirement -> Larva waiting / Larva accumulating
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Physiology advances or protein assimilation makes gate true. Gate uses tissue, not crop mass. Always settle maintenance and water. Accrue developmental time only once tissue threshold holds
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B07: §§2.1–2.3, 2.5, 3.1–3.2, 3.4; Table 1, Figs. 2–4, 6, 8 captions | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | B07: Data S1 Tables S1–S4 and Dryad DATA_combined.txt, census 2/8 by species | B07-X: Dryad Lasius_pulseisotopedata.txt and author pulse script, 32 labeled caste/time aliquots
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Temperature-dependent diapause in first brood; diet-dependent growth; non-target tracer enrichment
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The model stops stage-time accumulation at a single protein threshold. A cohort development delay or pooled tracer cannot identify that threshold or substitute for temperature-driven diapause. Table 1 detects diet and time-by-diet effects on repeated worker counts in both species. Table S3 detects a diet effect on census 8 minus census 2 only in L. niger and a feeding-frequency effect in both species. These colony endpoints do not establish an individual nutrient rule.

CodeElement: Egg -> Larva
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Egg days and actual rearing temperature by population, Table 2
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Egg-to-larva endpoint is a candidate future comparison when temperature and population are matched. Fixed source duration does not capture the observed response.

CodeElement: Larva -> Pupa
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Hatch to cocoon formation days and diapause outcomes
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Source age is gated by tissue and ends at model pupation. Laboratory larval time includes all intervening nutrition and is not measured from tissue threshold crossing.

CodeElement: Pupa -> Adult
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Owned wake at exact stage duration. Alive with both stores positive. Larval clock requires adequate tissue. Commit next ordinal on same AntId and reset stage clock. Schedule eligible adulthood autonomy and next physiology
EvidenceLocators: B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2 | B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Cocoon/prepupal interval to emergence and sexual pupal respiration
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The closest timing observation pools prepupa and pupa. There is no measured mapping to a standalone model Pupa timer or inferred stage-specific energy cost.

CodeElement: Egg / Larva / Pupa / Adult -> Dead
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Settled energy or hydration reaches zero. EnergyDepleted wins when both zero. Death checked before assimilation or development. Record death, decrement living count, remove contact and stop owned programs
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Foundress and first-brood viability across assays
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The exact zero-store death boundary, energy/water precedence and death before assimilation at equal time are not observed biological thresholds.

CodeElement: None -> EnergyDepleted / Dehydrated / Fixture
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Biological threshold death or manual fixture death. Cancel reproduction and care even before the physiology component check. Clear physiology/behavior events and set Paused on retained physiology row
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Fixture death and exact software depletion labels determine cancellation. They do not identify a cause for a dead laboratory ant.

CodeElement: Alive eligible stage -> Component demand / zero
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Decision uses contacted candidate's state. Larval total protein or long-term urgent reserves. Adult urgency or protein target. Other stages empty. Compute component deficits after counting existing crop
EvidenceLocators: N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B07-X: §§2.4, 3.3; Fig. 7 (L. neoniger only) | B07-X: Dryad Lasius_pulseisotopedata.txt and author pulse script, 32 labeled caste/time aliquots
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Worker deprivation contrasts and separate isotope distribution in L. neoniger
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: No observed direct access to numeric reserve headroom, larval protein target or adult quarter-capacity threshold. Tracer endpoint is from a congener.

CodeElement: NutritionWake in Rest or Nurse -> Rest / IngestCargo / WithdrawNest / ReturnProtein / Trophallaxis
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Local action policy selects at committed boundary. Gift-first and urgent self gating. Recycling when enabled. Half-crop intake. Compatible recipient and positive supply. Queue one action at +1 ms with configured transfer limit if non-Rest
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | R1L: pp. 154–158, 161–164, 172; Tables 1, 3–5
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed intake, directional oral bouts and overlapping worker roles
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: There is no experimental counterpart to gift-first, rest recycling or intake below half crop. Feeding by observed foragers cannot be mapped directly to the Forage state.

CodeElement: IngestCargo / WithdrawNest -> CargoIngested / NestIngested / ActionRejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Resolved intake. For depot require real nest contact and clearance. Bound by crop room and supply, optionally capped by local deficits. Move actual component mass to crop, update cargo/depot ledger
EvidenceLocators: N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Individual intake-volume proxy and offered foundress diet
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Cargo/depot provenance and exact crop-room limits are model accounting. Available donor intake is not evidence of a maximum recipient-specific withdrawal.

CodeElement: Trophallaxis proposal -> NutritionTransferred / ActionRejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Resolved donor-recipient action. Living Adult/Larva, same-colony contact and geometry, exchange enabled, nonempty compatible supply and recipient capacity. Debit donor crop and credit recipient crop with actual amount and Success/Partial
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | R1L: pp. 154–158, 161–164, 172; Tables 1, 3–5
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Worker oral contact durations/counts and documented larva or queen recipient
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: No matching simultaneous outcome for recipient acceptance, component mass, rejected proposals, castes and duration. Distinguish observation of oral exchange from one atomic transfer.

CodeElement: ReturnProtein -> ProteinRecycled / ActionRejected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Reachable depot and recycling policy. Available crop protein and positive requested amount. Debit crop and credit pure protein to depot
EvidenceLocators: B08: Methods; Results, Table 1, Figs. 2–5; supplement events workbook | N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed exchange only. No pure-protein depot return measured.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Recycling is an explicit source/sink rule without a demonstrated regurgitation, storage or reclamation process.

CodeElement: Owned completed or rejected nutrition action -> Next NutritionWake
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Action resolves. For successful Nurse depot intake plus post_intake_contact use +1 ms. Otherwise ordinary interval. Reconsider local contact at next wake
EvidenceLocators: N01: pp. 178–181, Methods and Results, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Elapsed seconds in an observed worker bout
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: One millisecond is a queue boundary after depot intake. Oral bout time is not a post-intake rearm delay.

CodeElement: Disabled -> Scheduled attempt
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Setup enrollment. Physiological Adult Queen with social and long-term config at time zero. Record activation and schedule interval
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Adult Queen enrollment and fixture flags control entry. A scheduled attempt does not correspond to first mating, first oviposition or ovarian maturation.

CodeElement: Scheduled attempt -> Deferred / egg funded
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Reproduction wake. Requires exact funded body and crop reserves and local clearance. Defer unchanged or interrupt owned care, debit maternal costs and create one Egg. Rearm.
EvidenceLocators: B01: pp. 1048–1049, 1053, §§2.2.13–2.2.14, 3.8; Fig. 4a only | B03: journal pp. 398–399, Experimental details and Results; Fig. 1A–B | FT01: p. 3 and pp. 6–13, Table 1, Figs. 5–9 | B03: Appendices S1–S2, day-49 queen endpoints and Table S2-2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Egg counts and brood-conditioned trajectories, plus foundress reserve histology All 240 observed endpoints retained in the descriptive check. The weekly-cricket treatment is an offered diet.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Resource limitation is plausible. Exact funded inequalities, one egg per scheduled attempt, two-day maintenance example and clearance gating have no comparable measurements.

CodeElement: Scheduled attempt -> Inactive
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Physiological or explicit lifecycle death. Registered reproduction exists. Cancel wake
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Death cancels a pending owned attempt. Evidence on aging, diapause or reversible infertility is not represented by cancellation.

CodeElement: Funded maternal allocation -> Worker Egg and enrolled juvenile
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful birth transaction. Single entity allocation and nutrient budget checks. Retain stable ID, parent, indexed position, physiology, lifecycle and canonical birth facts
EvidenceLocators: B05: pp. 20–23, Fig. 3, Tables 1–2 | N27: pp. 2–7, Methods, Table 1, Fig. 3 | B06: pp. 166–172, 1994 Methods and Results, Tables 1–2
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Sexual energetic investment, distinct caste oxygen use and immature stage times
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Single allocation at mother's location and copying rates preserve identity and conservation. No comparable per-egg allocation or lineage-dependent rate map was identified.

CodeElement: Reachable sampled neighbor -> Opportunity or excluded
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Alive, surface path and geometry, colony/stage rule, physical contact. Emit per-target opportunity facts before choice. No claim of successful contact
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Scored close interactions and timestamped first contact
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The index, colony and geometry gates create an Opportunity record. This does not demonstrate detection or define the laboratory contact sample denominator.

CodeElement: Unconfigured / unenrolled -> Configured / dedicated program pending
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Explicit setup and enable. Long-term social world, valid profiles and living adult Worker or Queen with paused physiology, no ordinary ownership and initial contact with own shelter. Store individual context and shelter, record enrollment and schedule first wake
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Setup installs profiles and initial shelter. Enrolling a paused adult at a clear location does not establish a measured propensity to start nursing.

CodeElement: Ordinary autonomy -> Care owns motor
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Eligible autonomous policy choice. Reachable own brood or queen worker contact at depot, or valid return toward previously known shelter. Worker becomes Nurse without normal social motor, queen retains distinct path, ordinary wake remains
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Care variation with workers and observed overlapping retrieval and foraging by individuals
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A reducing path to one stored shelter or reachable local stimulus is an admission rule. No equivalent serialized motor or decision clock was measured.

CodeElement: Owned integrated care -> Released, program Paused
CurrentRuleOrGuard: No selected act. Integrated mode, idle act. Disable lease and record release. Ordinary policy can select future work.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Cessation/recovery of active care and heterogeneous worker roles
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: One inactive decision releases the motor. Neither study observes a program pause, idle-event trigger or minimum continuous care lease.

CodeElement: Eligible adult queen -> CloseWorkerContact selected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake with reachable workers. Capable and no continued retrieval. Separate contact probability. Choose one contact uniformly. Physical completion needed for memory
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Workers in close contact vs worker absence and mesh manipulation Mesh analysis has 43 queens and 127 retained observation windows.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The probability draw, in-range prerequisite and no continuation condition do not follow from the experiment. Antennation remained possible across the mesh.

CodeElement: No worker contact or older contact -> Most recent contact time refreshed
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful CloseWorkerContact end. Target still adult worker, accessible and not conflicting. Set has_worker_contact and last_worker_contact
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Direct social access and recovery after worker removal Mesh analysis has 43 queens and 127 retained observation windows.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: B01 does not timestamp a causal worker bout or determine whether only successful completed interactions refresh a memory.

CodeElement: Recorded contact time -> Reduced new care probability or no inhibition
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Subsequent eligible local brood wake. Elapsed-time linear decay bounded below by zero. Ongoing retrieval bypasses draw. Affects new brood selection. No fact claiming unselected care occurred.
EvidenceLocators: B01: pp. 1045–1048, 1049–1052, §§2.1.4, 2.2.3–2.2.5, 2.2.8–2.2.12; §§3.1–3.6, Figs. 1–2 | B01: pp. 1047, 1049–1051, §§2.2.3 and 3.2, Fig. 1b; supplementary Fig. S5 cited in main text | B01: Data S1 Fig. S3, Tables S1–S2, Appendix S1 wire-mesh exclusions
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Worker-induced care reduction and restoration per focal queen; no detected food-treatment effect on care Mesh analysis has 43 queens and 127 retained observation windows.
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: No observed recency kernel, inhibition maximum or bypass for ongoing retrieval. Worker presence/contact, workload relief and exact cue remain distinct hypotheses.

CodeElement: Inactive / visible or remembered brood -> ApproachBrood / PickUpBrood / legacy TransportBrood
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Displaced reachable local brood, clear owned target or reacquire. Contact decides phase. Store one visible target, choose next movement or handling bout
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: First contact and retrieval outcomes; preferential stage ranks in paired presentation
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: No reported exact coordinates, hidden detection time or data identifying the displaced-lock and remembered-target priority. The stage ranks do not establish uniform choice.

CodeElement: Sheltered brood in contact -> InspectBrood / ArrangeBrood / CleanBrood / FeedBrood
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake selecting accessible target. Feed additionally requires larval physiology and compatible caregiver crop. Uniform draw of eligible acts, with explicit arrangement destination or real transfer at end
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Active handling, licking and regurgitation categories
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The uniform 3/4 act draw and exact larval-demand/crop guard are unmeasured. The human active-care scan merges some acts.

CodeElement: Active manipulation -> Brood displaced / nutrients moved / no physiological change
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful CareEnd for chosen act. Still reachable valid target and conflict-free. Arrangement commits movement. Feed invokes normal trophallaxis checks and facts. Inspect and Clean finish without nutrient transfer.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Observed handling or transfer acts, no hygiene or per-bout nutrient payload
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Exact displacement, nutrient amount, cancellation and successful no-change acts cannot be inferred from a category label.

CodeElement: In contact -> Held
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful PickUpBrood end. Actor and brood remain reachable and geometrically clear. Store exclusive custody, pickup site and fixed continuous grip offset
EvidenceLocators: B02: pp. 10411–10413, §§2.2–2.3, §3; Fig. 1; Dryad all-data table | R1C: pp. 276–281, 290–296, Tables II and IV
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Handling and retrieval markers and physical carrying
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Exclusive lock and contact revalidation avoid contradictory positions. The studies cannot identify a pickup duration, grip rule or success probability.

CodeElement: Held / legacy transport -> Position changes under load
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful TransportBrood end. Physical carrier and brood sweeps clear, lock and contact valid. Commit both positions with child history. Under timed carry, retain lock between bouts.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Loaded worker movement, distance and time from selected repeated paths
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Two trained workers give a conditional magnitude reference. There is no population velocity distribution with comparable load or assay geometry. Spatial sweeps and rigid offset are engineering requirements.

CodeElement: Held near shelter -> Placed and released
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Successful PlaceBrood end. Valid live custody and shelter proximity, load clearance. Release lock and grip, clear active target, choose post-placement wake
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Brood returned to familiar shelter and repeated removal assays
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: The reported marker is not aligned to a commit instant for placement. Under the previous line layout the reviewed count was 6/6 in both model arms.

CodeElement: Real current position -> Direct / reducing-axis / blocked candidate
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Select a local motion segment. In bounds, arena, surface and physical carrier and load clearance. Plan bounded motion and recheck on begin and end. Time comes from selected distance and act
EvidenceLocators: R1C: pp. 276–281, 290–296, Tables II and IV
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Carrying orientation under altered visual cues
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Actual geometric clearance is required. The direction fallback, speed and clipping are not identified by orientation choices.

CodeElement: Returning / known pickup -> ReturnToCareShelter / RevisitBroodSite
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Remembered destination and state priority. Choose distance-reducing local segment. Clear consumed pickup memory. Finish lease at shelter.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Repeated departure/transport and orientation from known site
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Repeating a trip does not isolate local site memory, visual guidance or chemical recruitment. Exact revisit priority and one-entry storage are model choices.

CodeElement: Capable dedicated care without visible brood -> Walk
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. No higher-priority action and no integrated lease. Draw planar direction and advance finite search-step counter
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Time to first observed contact and repeated paths described qualitatively
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A uniform four-direction step in dedicated care is a fixture. The studies provide neither an empty-view walk distribution nor matching approach distance.

CodeElement: No eligible act or infeasible legacy segment -> Inactive / integrated lease ends
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Can be inhibited, incapable, blocked or already home. Dedicated mode runs timed inactivity. Integrated mode releases motor rather than staying idle.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Nonpositive active scans and retrieval trials without the target event
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A release or blocked wake cannot identify physiological incapacity, satiation, geometry or social inhibition from a scan or censored trial.

CodeElement: Active / pending / carrying -> Interrupted, reset or disabled
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Explicit or causal interruption. Configured care and relevant owned lock or bout. Cancel event, clear target and grip. Retain committed positions, optionally schedule return
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Cancellation releases custody and future ownership without undoing committed motion. No biological interruption hazard is assigned.

CodeElement: Foreign neighboring brood -> Candidate or excluded
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Dedicated timed neutral assay, Larva/Pupa, displaced or held. Allow limited retrieval without reassignment or general foreign feeding
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: Origin-paired count test plus summer/autumn rank and adoption outcomes
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Permitted displaced transport does not infer equal acceptance, nesting or feeding. The no-significance result does not estimate an equivalence margin.

CodeElement: Local decision -> Opportunity / Selected
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareWake. Contact eligible for opportunity. Selection only after potential inactive lease release. Record known source and target, no duration claimed
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: An indexed opportunity and a selected act are distinct event records. Neither constitutes successful physical contact.

CodeElement: Selected -> Started / Interrupted
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareBegin. Revalidate reach, target, stage, clearance and exclusive lock. On success claim lock and arm completion at actual bout end. Failure produces interruption without start.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A true start follows validation. Rejection or contention is recorded without inventing an observed bout.

CodeElement: Started -> Completed / Interrupted
CurrentRuleOrGuard: CareEnd. Revalidate and require real committed result for completion. Record amount, bout timing and failure. Rearm according to actual act and current program.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: A timed interval closes with a real completion or interruption. Do not count the entire program residence as activity.

CodeElement: Legacy committed resolution -> Walk / CollectFood / DeliverFood / IngestFood / FeedBrood / TransferNutrition / Excavate / HandleSoil
CurrentRuleOrGuard: Configured biology wrapper around existing action result. Success/partial generates instantaneous Started/Completed with duration unknown. Failure Interrupted. Mirror committed facts and payload. These labels do not independently start care motor.
MeasuredEndpointAndUnit: No biological endpoint; software mechanism
UnsupportedImplementationOrGap: Legacy action result wrappers do not acquire a measured duration. Nutrient payload and event type remain distinct from behavioral time.
